tools.name: start_website
tools.description: Start the guided Website Starter workflow. Use this first: it asks whether a project already exists (then clone it), otherwise interviews the person, creates the instruction-only ZIP, and continues in that folder.

tools.name: describe_starter
tools.description: Describe the Website Starter instruction set, its current version, public download, and safety boundaries.

tools.name: get_starter
tools.description: Return a direct public link to the current neutral instruction-only Website Starter ZIP. For a guided setup, use start_website first. No login is required.

tools.name: create_starter
tools.description: Create a customized instruction-only Website Starter ZIP after the start_website interview. Inputs are bounded and processed transiently; nothing is stored.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Start the guided Website Starter workflow. Use this first: it asks whether a project already exists (then clone it), otherwise interviews the person, creates the instruction-only ZIP, and continues in that folder."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
